newsitem.title: SPAIN: IMF sees Spain in EMU from the start in 1999.
newsitem.headline: IMF sees Spain in EMU from the start in 1999.

text.p: The International Monetary Fund (IMF) said Spain made great strides in 1996 and it appeared ready to enter European Monetary Union from the start in 1999.

In a report published after a recent visit by one of its committees, the IMF said Spain's GDP should grow by 2.8 percent in 1997, while there was a good possibility that inflation would be significantly lower than three percent.

On fiscal policy, it said the target of three percent budget deficit of GDP for 1997 to meet Maastricht criteria could be achieved if the country adhered to its 1997 budget and did not fall short as in previous years.
